findings.evidence: The proof’s only use of either instance is line 90, `hs.nullMeasurableSet_smul _`; coverage and disjointness use only `hs`, the action laws, and `hr`. Mathlib’s `IsFundamentalDomain.image_of_equiv` likewise accepts an explicit `QuasiMeasurePreserving` hypothesis rather than global invariance.
findings.fix: State the core theorem with `(hnull : ∀ i, NullMeasurableSet (r i • s) μ)` (or per-representative quasi-measure-preservation), use `hnull` in the first field, and derive the current invariant-action version as a convenience corollary if needed.
findings.issue: `iUnion_smul_of_transversal` assumes `[MeasurableConstSMul G α] [SMulInvariantMeasure G α μ]`, but these are used only to establish null-measurability of each `r i • s`; invariance and measurability for every ambient-group element are stronger than the theorem needs.

summary: The transversal theorem unnecessarily requires a measurable, measure-invariant action of the entire ambient group, although its proof only needs null-measurability of the selected translates.
